newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Airlines body to hold 1997 annual meet in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Airlines body to hold 1997 annual meet in Jordan.

text.p: The global airlines body IATA said on Tuesday it would hold its 1997 annual general meeting in the Jordanian capital of Amman on November 3-4.
The announcement was made at the end of the 254-member body's 1996 general meeting in Geneva, which shares its headquarters with Montreal in Canada.
The Geneva session elected Nader Dahabi, President and Chief Executive Officer of Royal Jordanian Airlines, as president for the Amman gathering.

Executives of airlines in IATA, the International Air Transport Association founded in 1945, also elected Cheong Choong Kong, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Singapore Airlines, as new chairman of its board of governors.
